arxiv-2001-10125.title: Simultaneous State and Unknown Input Set-Valued Observers for Some Classes of Nonlinear Dynamical Systems
arxiv-2001-10125.creator: Mohammad Khajenejad, Sze Zheng Yong
arxiv-2001-10125.description: Abstract In this paper, we propose fixed-order set-valued (in the form of ℓ 2 \ell_{2} -norm hyperballs) observers for some classes of nonlinear bounded-error dynamical systems with unknown input signals that simultaneously find bounded hyperballs of states and unknown inputs that include the true states and inputs.

arxiv-2107-13277.title: A Novel CropdocNet for Automated Potato Late Blight Disease Detection from the Unmanned Aerial Vehicle-based Hyperspectral Imagery
arxiv-2107-13277.creator: Yue Shi, Liangxiu Han, Anthony Kleerekoper, Sheng Chang, Tongle Hu
arxiv-2107-13277.description: Abstract Late blight disease is one of the most destructive diseases in potato crop, leading to serious yield losses globally. Accurate diagnosis of the disease at early stage is critical for precision disease control and management. Current farm practices in crop disease diagnosis are based on manual visual inspection, which is costly, time consuming, subject to individual bias.

arxiv-2201-01767.title: Observational hints on the torus obscuring gas behaviour through X-rays with NuSTAR data 2022 Observational hints on the torus obscuring gas behaviour through X-rays with NuSTAR data – 12
arxiv-2201-01767.creator: N. Osorio-Clavijo, O. González-Martín, S.F. Sánchez, D. Esparza-Arredondo, J. Masegosa, C. Victoria-Ceballos, L. Hernández-García Y. Díaz
arxiv-2201-01767.description: Abstract According to theory, the torus of active galactic nuclei (AGN) is sustained from a wind coming off the accretion disk, and for low efficient AGN, it has been proposed that such structure disappears. However, the exact conditions for its disappearance remain unclear.

arxiv-2212-06186.title: Light Scalars at FASER
arxiv-2212-06186.creator: Shuailong Li ♭, Huayang Song ♮, Shufang Su ♭, Wei Su †
arxiv-2212-06186.description: Abstract FASER, the ForwArd Search ExpeRiment, is a currently operating experiment at the Large Hadron Collider (LHC) that can detect light long-lived particles produced in the forward region of the LHC interacting point. In this paper, we study the prospect of detecting light CP-even and CP-odd scalars at FASER and FASER 2.

arxiv-2301-01270.title: Maurer-Cartan characterization, cohomology and deformations of equivariant Lie superalgebras Journal: …
arxiv-2301-01270.creator: RB Yadav, Subir Mukhopadhyay
arxiv-2301-01270.description: Abstract In this article, we give Maurer-Cartan characterizations of equivariant Lie superalgebra structures. We introduce equivariant cohomology and equivariant formal deformation theory of Lie superalgebras. As an application of equivariant cohomology we study the equivariant formal deformation theory of Lie superalgebras. As another application we characterize equivariant central extensions of Lie superalgebras using second equivariant cohomology.

arxiv-2312-00358.title: Impact of Data Augmentation on QCNNs
arxiv-2312-00358.creator: ng Zhouli lzhouli@student.unimelb.edu.au
arxiv-2312-00358.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by ng Zhouli lzhouli@student.unimelb.edu.au. In recent years, Classical Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have been applied for image recognition successfully. Quantum Convolutional Neural Networks (QCNNs) are proposed as a novel generalization to CNNs by using quantum mechanisms. The quantum mechanisms lead to an efficient training process in QCNNs by reducing the size of input from N N to l ​ o ​ g 2 ​ N log_{2}N .

arxiv-2404-11651.title: Neutrino Masses in the Mirror Twin Higgs with Spontaneous ℤ 2 \mathbb{Z}_{2} Breaking
arxiv-2404-11651.creator: Pedro Bittar, Davi B. Costa, Gustavo Burdman
arxiv-2404-11651.description: Abstract We introduce a mirror twin Higgs model with spontaneous ℤ 2 \mathbb{Z}_{2} symmetry breaking that ameliorates the constraints in twin Higgs cosmology and, at the same time, generates the Standard Model neutrino masses. The model features an S ​ U ​ ( 2 ) SU(2) triplet with hypercharge 1 1 alongside its twin counterpart.

arxiv-2405-16563.title: Higher-Order Transformer Derivative Estimates for Explicit Pathwise Learning Guarantees
arxiv-2405-16563.creator: Yannick Limmer, Anastasis Kratsios, Xuwei Yang, Raeid Saqur, Blanka Horvath
arxiv-2405-16563.description: Abstract An inherent challenge in computing fully- explicit generalization bounds for transformers involves obtaining covering number estimates for the given transformer class 𝒯 \mathcal{T} . Crude estimates rely on a uniform upper bound on the local-Lipschitz constants of transformers in 𝒯 \mathcal{T} , and finer estimates require an analysis of their higher-order partial derivatives.

arxiv-2412-18910.title: AdaEAGLE: Optimizing Speculative Decoding via Explicit Modeling of Adaptive Draft Structures
arxiv-2412-18910.creator: Situo Zhang, Hankun Wang, Da Ma, Zichen Zhu
arxiv-2412-18910.description: Abstract Speculative Decoding (SD) is a popular lossless technique for accelerating the inference of Large Language Models (LLMs). We show that the decoding speed of SD frameworks with static draft structures can be significantly improved by incorporating context-aware adaptive draft structures. However, current studies on adaptive draft structures are limited by their performance, modeling approaches, and applicability.

arxiv-2508-08872.title: Empirical Analysis of Temporal and Spatial Fault Characteristics in Multi-Fault Bug Repositories
arxiv-2508-08872.creator: Dylan Callaghan, Alexandra van der Spuy, Bernd Fischer
arxiv-2508-08872.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Dylan Callaghan, Alexandra van der Spuy, Bernd Fischer. Fixing software faults contributes significantly to the cost of software maintenance and evolution. Techniques for reducing these costs require datasets of software faults, as well as an understanding of the faults, for optimal testing and evaluation. In this paper, we present an empirical analysis of the temporal and spatial characteristics of faults existing in 16 open-source Java and Python projects, which form part of the Defects4J and BugsInPy datasets, respectively.

arxiv-2509-24710.title: MAD: Manifold Attracted Diffusion
arxiv-2509-24710.creator: Dennis Elbrächter, Giovanni S. Alberti, Matteo Santacesaria
arxiv-2509-24710.description: Abstract Score-based diffusion models are a highly effective method for generating samples from a distribution of images. We consider scenarios where the training data comes from a noisy version of the target distribution, and present an efficiently implementable modification of the inference procedure to generate noiseless samples.

pmc-11465468.title: A Constraint-Based Orbital-Optimized Excited State Method (COOX)
pmc-11465468.creator: Jörg Kussmann, Yannick Lemke, Anthea Weinbrenner, Christian Ochsenfeld
pmc-11465468.description: In this work, we present a novel method to directly calculate targeted electronic excited states within a self-consistent field calculation based on constrained density functional theory (cDFT). The constraint is constructed from the static occupied-occupied and virtual-virtual parts of the excited state difference density from (simplified) linear-response time-dependent density functional theory calculations (LR-TDDFT).

pmc-12575788.title: Liver dysfunction triggers early Alzheimer’s pathology in an adult rat model of chronic liver disease
pmc-12575788.creator: O Braissant, V A McLin, D Sessa, K Pierzchala
pmc-12575788.description: Emerging evidence links liver dysfunction to Alzheimer’s disease (AD), though few studies have investigated this connection. While cirrhosis is associated with cognitive impairment, its underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. This study aimed to assess the presence of central nervous system (CNS) markers of Alzheimer’s disease in a rat model of chronic liver disease.

pmc-13114281.title: Automated Gait Assessment for Rehabilitation Training Using Pose Tracking and Dynamic Time Warping
pmc-13114281.creator: Naomi Yagi, Kazuki Otsuka, Yuki Yamanaka, Kentaro Mori, Yutaka Hata, Yasumitsu Fujii, Yoshitada Sakai
pmc-13114281.description: Background: In rehabilitation medicine, efficient gait analysis is crucial for evaluating postoperative recovery and frailty, especially given the increasing burden on clinicians due to an aging population. Objectives: This study aims to conduct preliminary validation of an automated linear walking evaluation system using 2D AI posture tracking.

pmc-13270963.title: Primary Mitral Valve Sarcoma Mimicking Infective Endocarditis
pmc-13270963.creator: Jingzhi Huang, Shuo Chen, Hongwen Fei
pmc-13270963.description: Graphical abstractKeywords: Cardiac sarcoma; Mitral valve; Infective endocarditis; Misdiagnosis, Echocardiography Introduction Primary cardiac tumors represent a rare yet clinically significant group of diseases. Among these, cardiac angiosarcoma is the most prevalent malignant type, followed by fibrous histiocytoma and leiomyosarcoma. Primary cardiac liposarcoma only accounts for approximately 13% of primary malignant cardiac tumors with the potential for infiltration and metastasis.

pmc-13402818.title: Inhibition of the QPCT–PDIA4 axis rescues ΔF508 and N1303K CFTR in cystic fibrosis
pmc-13402818.creator: Le Sun, Larry Rodriguez, Sandra Pankow, Jolene Diedrich, Ke Qin, Jianan Zhang, Xu Wu, Peng Wu, John R. Yates
pmc-13402818.description: Cystic fibrosis (CF) is a genetic disorder caused by CFTR mutations, most commonly ΔF508, leading to defective ion transport and multisystem pathology. Small-molecule modulators partially restore mutant CFTR function, but therapeutic efficacy remains limited, particularly for N1303K mutation refractory to current treatments.
